note: Officially named target or candidate regions WITHOUT published numeric coordinates in the sources this project verified. They are listed for honesty and are deliberately NOT shown on the globe and NOT analysed - the app never invents coordinates (research workbook decision D-04). A region can share a name with an analysed site (e.g. Mons Mouton / IM-2, Malapert / IM-1): the site is a single published landing point, while the region is a wider candidate area whose boundary has not been published. Mission status as of 2026-11-15; schedules change often.
statusAsOf: 2026-11-15 (post-hackathon review: CLPS per NASA Moon Base update of 2026-11-07 [S52]; Artemis per LPSC 2026 [S54] and the Feb-2026 architecture change [S55])
